change_type_matrix.notes: Validate JSON files directly. No project tests required unless docs alter executable commands.
Run `uv run pytest` — it is authoritative and runs green (524 passed, 0 skipped this checkout). If pytest fails to start, run `uv sync --dev` first to repair a stale .venv, then re-run.
Prefer targeted tests in tests/test_normalize.py, tests/test_storage-related behavior via test_cases.py, and tests/test_priority.py when available.
Run dashboard manually only when the task requires browser/API verification.
Use the React/Vite source in dashboard-ui as the editable source; bundled assets under src/security_observatory/dashboard are generated build output.
Run desktop-install and desktop-quit only when the task requires installed-app validation or cleanup.
Do not run installer, CI scanner installs, or network scanner bootstrap commands unless explicitly needed. Review .adx/risks.json first.
This writes local reports under ~/.security-observatory and may call external scanner binaries. Run only for scanner behavior validation.
